test_cases.summary:
Verify Admin can view bucket registry page
when the admin logs into the system
test_cases.description:
Feature: Multi-Bucket Registration
Scenario: Admin can view bucket registry page
Given the admin logs into the system
When navigating to Bucket Configuration screen
Then the bucket registry list should be displayed
test_cases.acceptance:
The bucket registry list should be displayed
The behavior should be validated when navigating to Bucket Configuration screen.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Add Bucket button visible
when the registry page is open
test_cases.description:
Feature: Multi-Bucket Registration
Scenario: Add Bucket button visible
Given the registry page is open
When the page loads
Then an “Add Bucket” button should be available
test_cases.acceptance:
An "Add Bucket" button should be available
The behavior should be validated when the page loads.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Open Add Bucket modal
when the user clicks Add Bucket
test_cases.description:
Feature: Multi-Bucket Registration
Scenario: Open Add Bucket modal
Given the user clicks Add Bucket
When the action is triggered
Then a modal form should open for bucket details entry
test_cases.acceptance:
A modal form should open for bucket details entry
The behavior should be validated when the action is triggered.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Enter bucket metadata
when the modal is open
test_cases.description:
Feature: Multi-Bucket Registration
Scenario: Enter bucket metadata
Given the modal is open
When the user fills provider, region, lifecycle policy, and credentials
Then all fields should accept valid input
test_cases.acceptance:
All fields should accept valid input
The behavior should be validated when the user fills provider, region, lifecycle policy, and credentials.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Save bucket successfully
when valid bucket metadata is entered
test_cases.description:
Feature: Multi-Bucket Registration
Scenario: Save bucket successfully
Given valid bucket metadata is entered
When the user clicks Save
Then the bucket should be stored in the registry and listed
test_cases.acceptance:
The bucket should be stored in the registry and listed
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks Save.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Mandatory field validation
when required fields are empty
test_cases.description:
Feature: Multi-Bucket Registration
Scenario: Mandatory field validation
Given required fields are empty
When Save is clicked
Then inline validation errors should appear and save should be blocked
test_cases.acceptance:
Inline validation errors should appear and save should be blocked
The behavior should be validated when Save is clicked.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Prevent duplicate bucket registration
when an existing bucket name already registered
test_cases.description:
Feature: Multi-Bucket Registration
Scenario: Prevent duplicate bucket registration
Given an existing bucket name already registered
When the same bucket is added again
Then the system should prevent saving and show error
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should prevent saving and show error
The behavior should be validated when the same bucket is added again.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Edit bucket configuration
when a bucket exists in the list
test_cases.description:
Feature: Multi-Bucket Registration
Scenario: Edit bucket configuration
Given a bucket exists in the list
When the user clicks Edit
Then existing values should load in modal for update
test_cases.acceptance:
Existing values should load in modal for update
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks Edit.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Update bucket details
when the edit modal is open
test_cases.description:
Feature: Multi-Bucket Registration
Scenario: Update bucket details
Given the edit modal is open
When changes are saved
Then updated metadata should reflect immediately in registry
test_cases.acceptance:
Updated metadata should reflect immediately in registry
The behavior should be validated when changes are saved.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Status badge display
when buckets exist
test_cases.description:
Feature: Multi-Bucket Registration
Scenario: Status badge display
Given buckets exist
When viewing registry
Then each bucket should show Active or Inactive status badge
test_cases.acceptance:
Each bucket should show Active or Inactive status badge
The behavior should be validated when viewing registry.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Services fetch configuration dynamically
when services require storage routing
test_cases.description:
Feature: Multi-Bucket Registration
Scenario: Services fetch configuration dynamically
Given services require storage routing
When an operation is executed
Then bucket configuration should be retrieved from registry dynamically
test_cases.acceptance:
Bucket configuration should be retrieved from registry dynamically
The behavior should be validated when an operation is executed.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Unauthorized users restricted
when a non-admin user logs in
test_cases.description:
Feature: Multi-Bucket Registration
Scenario: Unauthorized users restricted
Given a non-admin user logs in
When accessing bucket configuration page
Then access should be denied or hidden
test_cases.acceptance:
Access should be denied or hidden
The behavior should be validated when accessing bucket configuration page.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Cancel action discards changes
when the modal is open with changes
test_cases.description:
Feature: Multi-Bucket Registration
Scenario: Cancel action discards changes
Given the modal is open with changes
When Cancel is clicked
Then no data should be saved
test_cases.acceptance:
No data should be saved
The behavior should be validated when Cancel is clicked.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Registration failure handling
when backend error occurs during save
test_cases.description:
Feature: Multi-Bucket Registration
Scenario: Registration failure handling
Given backend error occurs during save
When the request fails
Then a clear error message should be displayed and configuration not saved
test_cases.acceptance:
A clear error message should be displayed and configuration not saved
The behavior should be validated when the request fails.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Registry loads quickly
when multiple buckets are configured
test_cases.description:
Feature: Multi-Bucket Registration
Scenario: Registry loads quickly
Given multiple buckets are configured
When opening the registry page
Then data should load within acceptable time (<2s)
test_cases.acceptance:
Data should load within acceptable time (<2s)
The behavior should be validated when opening the registry page.

test_cases.summary:
Verify No bucket selector visible in UI
when the user opens labeling or asset listing screen
test_cases.description:
Feature: Transparent Bucket Resolution
Scenario: No bucket selector visible in UI
Given the user opens labeling or asset listing screen
When the page renders
Then no manual bucket selection control should be displayed
test_cases.acceptance:
No manual bucket selection control should be displayed
The behavior should be validated when the page renders.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Automatic bucket resolution during asset fetch
when asset metadata contains bucket mapping
test_cases.description:
Feature: Transparent Bucket Resolution
Scenario: Automatic bucket resolution during asset fetch
Given asset metadata contains bucket mapping
When an asset is opened
Then the system should automatically resolve and fetch from the mapped bucket
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should automatically resolve and fetch from the mapped bucket
The behavior should be validated when an asset is opened.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Resolution during write operation
when a user applies labels to an asset
test_cases.description:
Feature: Transparent Bucket Resolution
Scenario: Resolution during write operation
Given a user applies labels to an asset
When the system saves changes
Then the correct bucket should be selected automatically for storage
test_cases.acceptance:
The correct bucket should be selected automatically for storage
The behavior should be validated when the system saves changes.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Bucket determined from metadata and session context
when asset metadata and session context are available
test_cases.description:
Feature: Transparent Bucket Resolution
Scenario: Bucket determined from metadata and session context
Given asset metadata and session context are available
When resolution occurs
Then both inputs should be evaluated to determine correct bucket
test_cases.acceptance:
Both inputs should be evaluated to determine correct bucket
The behavior should be validated when resolution occurs.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Multiple buckets configured
when multiple storage buckets exist
test_cases.description:
Feature: Transparent Bucket Resolution
Scenario: Multiple buckets configured
Given multiple storage buckets exist
When different assets are accessed
Then each asset should resolve to its mapped bucket independently
test_cases.acceptance:
Each asset should resolve to its mapped bucket independently
The behavior should be validated when different assets are accessed.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Resolution occurs hooking before operation
when an asset operation is triggered
test_cases.description:
Feature: Transparent Bucket Resolution
Scenario: Resolution occurs hooking before operation
Given an asset operation is triggered
When processing starts
Then bucket resolution should occur before read/write execution
test_cases.acceptance:
Bucket resolution should occur before read/write execution
The behavior should be validated when processing starts.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Default fallback when mapping missing
when bucket mapping is unavailable
test_cases.description:
Feature: Transparent Bucket Resolution
Scenario: Default fallback when mapping missing
Given bucket mapping is unavailable
When resolution occurs
Then the system should use the default bucket automatically
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should use the default bucket automatically
The behavior should be validated when resolution occurs.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Missing mapping logged
when bucket mapping fails
test_cases.description:
Feature: Transparent Bucket Resolution
Scenario: Missing mapping logged
Given bucket mapping fails
When fallback is applied
Then resolution failure should be logged with traceId and assetId
test_cases.acceptance:
Resolution failure should be logged with traceId and assetId
The behavior should be validated when fallback is applied.

test_cases.summary:
Verify User cannot override bucket manually
when the user attempts to manipulate request payload
test_cases.description:
Feature: Transparent Bucket Resolution
Scenario: User cannot override bucket manually
Given the user attempts to manipulate request payload
When submitting operation
Then system should ignore manual bucket inputs and resolve automatically
test_cases.acceptance:
System should ignore manual bucket inputs and resolve automatically
The behavior should be validated when submitting operation.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Resolution latency minimal
when an asset request occurs
test_cases.description:
Feature: Transparent Bucket Resolution
Scenario: Resolution latency minimal
Given an asset request occurs
When bucket resolution executes
Then resolution should not introduce noticeable delay (<100ms overhead)
test_cases.acceptance:
Resolution should not introduce noticeable delay (<100ms overhead)
The behavior should be validated when bucket resolution executes.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Workflow remains seamless
when users perform labeling or viewing
test_cases.description:
Feature: Transparent Bucket Resolution
Scenario: Workflow remains seamless
Given users perform labeling or viewing
When interacting with assets
Then no extra steps or configuration should be required for storage selection
test_cases.acceptance:
No extra steps or configuration should be required for storage selection
The behavior should be validated when interacting with assets.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Concurrent operations resolve correctly
when multiple assets are processed simultaneously
test_cases.description:
Feature: Transparent Bucket Resolution
Scenario: Concurrent operations resolve correctly
Given multiple assets are processed simultaneously
When resolution runs in parallel
Then each asset should map to its correct bucket without conflict
test_cases.acceptance:
Each asset should map to its correct bucket without conflict
The behavior should be validated when resolution runs in parallel.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Buckets bound during session initialization
when a valid session configuration exists
test_cases.description:
Feature: Session–Bucket Association
Scenario: Buckets bound during session initialization
Given a valid session configuration exists
When the session loads
Then resolved bucket identifiers should be bound to the session context automatically
test_cases.acceptance:
Resolved bucket identifiers should be bound to the session context automatically
The behavior should be validated when the session loads.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Multiple buckets supported per session
when multiple buckets are mapped
test_cases.description:
Feature: Session–Bucket Association
Scenario: Multiple buckets supported per session
Given multiple buckets are mapped
When the session initializes
Then all associated bucket identifiers should be stored together
test_cases.acceptance:
All associated bucket identifiers should be stored together
The behavior should be validated when the session initializes.
